title: Instagram Profile Scraper - Public Profile Analytics
description: Public profile statistics, published bio links, optional recent-post summaries and comparable watchlist changes. Bounded HTTP only; no login or private profiles.

usernames.title: Instagram Usernames or Profile URLs
usernames.description: Enter up to 50 unique public-profile usernames, @handles or profile URLs. Posts/Reels URLs are not profile inputs. Invalid entries are counted in OUTPUT; duplicates are collapsed before requests.

includeRecentPosts.title: Include Available Recent Posts and Activity
includeRecentPosts.description: Include up to maxRecentPosts from the existing public profile response, with sample engagement, post mix and latest-post date. No scrolling, pagination or media downloads. Missing/hidden stats stay null; an empty sample does not mean inactive.

maxRecentPosts.title: Maximum Recent-Post Sample
maxRecentPosts.description: Cap the available recent-post sample, not a guarantee of how many Instagram exposes.

monitorStoreName.title: Watchlist History Name (Optional)
monitorStoreName.description: Reuse a name (letters, numbers, _ or -) to compare successful public-profile observations in your own account's storage. Blank disables history. Up to 500 profiles / 10 observations each / 2 MB / 30-day comparison window; oldest observations are evicted at size bounds. Do not overlap runs sharing a name. Failed/private/unobserved targets do not become follower-loss events.

followerChangeThresholdPercent.title: Follower Change Flag Threshold (%)
followerChangeThresholdPercent.description: Flag an absolute percentage change only when both follower counts are exact and comparable. Flags do not send notifications. Zero baselines, missing/rounded counts and identity changes cannot produce percentage alerts.

maxRunSeconds.title: Soft Source-Request Runtime Limit (Seconds)
maxRunSeconds.description: Stop source requests and preserve saved results at this limit. Default 240 seconds; reporting/storage cleanup may take additional time. Large or blocked batches can be partial.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential is the default when omitted. Explicit no-proxy/custom settings remain supported but may be blocked. At most two fresh sessions and four HTTP requests per target; complete public HTML avoids the optional second metadata request.
